notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
[b]Hello, MMA Arena Community![/b]

We're thrilled to share some exciting news about the latest update to MMA ARENA. Our team has been hard at work, and we're now ready to roll out significant improvements to enhance your gaming experience.

🌟 [b]Major Engine Update:[/b] We've upgraded the entire game engine to the latest version. This is a big step forward, allowing us to fix existing issues more efficiently and pave the way for adding fresh, exciting content to the game.

🛠[b] Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b] We've listened to your feedback and addressed several issues that you've reported. Here's a quick rundown of the key fixes:

[b]Competition Achievements:[/b] We've fixed the bugs affecting competition achievements. You should now find them working as intended, recognizing and rewarding your hard-earned victories.

[b]Store Stability: [/b]The issue causing the store to freeze has been resolved. Shopping for your favorite gear and items should now be a smooth, hassle-free experience.

We're committed to continually improving MMA ARENA, and your feedback is invaluable in this journey. Keep those comments coming, and stay tuned for more updates and enhancements in the future.

Thank you for being a part of the MMA ARENA community!

Happy Fighting!
The MMA ARENA Team

notes.title: Updates, bugs and fixes!
notes.content:
[b][i]Dear MMA Arena Community,[/i][/b]

We're thrilled to share some exciting news with all of you! Over the last year , our team has been hard at work addressing some persistent issues in MMA Arena. We've recognized that the game was originally built on an older version of the game engine, causing more complications than anticipated. This required us to undergo a significant conversion process, taking up more time than we initially expected.

However, we're ecstatic to announce that we're finally in a position to roll out a comprehensive fix with our upcoming patch scheduled for this week. We've dedicated ourselves to not only resolving these technical hurdles but also ensuring that future updates will be smoother and quicker to implement.

[b]Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us[/b]. We'd love to hear any ideas or suggestions you have for enhancing the game. Your input has always been instrumental in shaping the MMA Arena experience, and we're eager to continue working together to make it even better.

[hr][/hr]

[b][i]Thank you [/i][/b]for your patience and ongoing support. Get ready to dive back into the octagon with the improved MMA Arena. Stay tuned for the patch release this week, and let's make the game even more fantastic together!

notes.content:
Hello, fighters, 
1.3 version is out
We focus to fix most of the issues we had like:

[list]
[*] Selection character icon is now fixed on the main screen
[*] Tutorial dialogues are working correctly now
[*] Performance fixes
[*] Deck UI fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Ranking system
notes.content:
Hi everyone.
With the latest update on MMA Arena 
[list]
[*]We fixed the bug that locked 59th fight in the career mode
[*]We also introduced a ranking system. If you have a fighter level 5 or higher you can now play Ranked matches. Depending on the way you achieve your victory (KO, TKO, Submission, etc) you gain rank points, but also losing cost you points!
[/list]
